entities.summary: Gregor Arbet is a former Estonian professional basketball player and the current assistant coach for TalTech of the Estonian Korvpalli Meistriliiga. He is a 1.96 m tall shooting guard and small forward. He represented the Estonian national basketball team internationally from 2002 to 2019.
